Team —

Quick ask as we prep the leadership binder for the monthly review (deadline: EOD Thurs):

1) Final stage updates: please ensure every open opportunity in the Q3 slate has a one-line rationale for current stage ("need legal signoff", "POC complete — awaiting budget owner", etc.) in the attached stage grid.
2) Commit flags: flag any deals you are willing to include in the commit number with the "YES - commit" tag in column G.
3) Risk notes: if there's a >60% risk of slip or push, add a brief mitigation plan in the notes column.
4) Exec slide intake: use the exec_binder_template.pdf (attached) and drop a single slide for any deal you want highlighted.

Attachments: 2026Q3_exec_binder_template.pdf, acme_stage_grid.xlsx

Timing: submit updated grid + any slides by 5pm PT Thursday 9/17. I'll collate and route to finance + exec. If you can't make the window, ping me with what you'll deliver and when.

Thanks —
Grace
